item.title: Morioka Castle Ruins & Iwate Park: City Cherry Blossoms — Guide
item.description: Morioka Castle was one of Tohoku’s great fortresses. Only the stone walls remain, but they are spectacular — rising over the Nakatsu River with Iwate-san volcano framed behind. The surrounding Iwate Park (Morioka Castle Ruins Park) is the city’s finest cherry blossom spot, with over 300 trees. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Morioka, Iwate Hours Park always open Admission Free Time needed About 1 hour Best time Late April (cherry blossoms) What to See Spectacular Edo-era stone walls above the river.
